description: Main window. The app deliberately grants no filesystem or shell permission to the webview — every privileged operation goes through a Rust command, so the frontend can only ask for the operations that exist. `opener:allow-open-url` carries an explicit https-only scope: allow-open-url on its own enables the command with an empty scope, which rejects every URL, and the broader `allow-default-urls` would also hand the webview http:, mailto: and tel:.
